items.content:
Later hours in winter at three branches. Costs staff time we don't have.

Wrote it anyway and sent it up. It will die at the second desk. Writing
it is the record that someone asked, and in four years when a consultant
recommends exactly this, the memo will have a date on it.

summary: Winter later-hours memo sent up to die, filed as a dated record
title: A proposal that will not survive
